we define the Gaussian Error Linear Unit (GELU) as
GELU(x) = xP (X ≤ x) = xΦ(x) = x ·  1 2 h 1 + erf(x/ √ 2) i .
We can approximate the GELU with
0.5x(1 + tanh[ p 2/π(x + 0.044715x 3 )])
or xσ(1.702x), if greater feedforward speed is worth the cost of exactness.
